attribution: none required; the project credits Wikidata voluntarily
constraints: Wikidata:Licensing (verified 2026-09-22): 'All structured data in the main, property and lexeme namespaces is made available under the Creative Commons CC0 License'

query service limits (https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikidata_Query_Service/User_Manual, verified 2026-09-22): 60 s query timeout, 60 s of processing time per client per 60 s, 30 error queries per minute, 5 parallel queries per IP, HTTP 429 with Retry-After when exceeded; a descriptive User-Agent is required or the client may be blocked
only names of humans (Q5) are sampled; nothing is stored beyond country of citizenship, name labels, and birth decade used for slicing
living people are public figures on Wikidata; the project stores names only, never any other attribute
format: SPARQL CSV results, one file per country, label language, and birth year; a year that reaches the 5000-row limit is replaced by one file per month

filters.rules: native name (P1559) used when in the label language's script; names NFC with whitespace collapsed; dropped: parentheses, commas, slashes, or ASCII digits; over 60 bytes; dominant script not the language's; fewer than two alphabetic tokens in Latin or Georgian; duplicates by (country, lowercase name)

notes: The page https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:SPARQL_query_service/Query_limits named in the plan returns 404; the limits live in the User Manual on mediawiki.org.
sha256_rule: over the cached files concatenated in sorted file-name order
split_rule: fnv1a64(0, lowercase normalized name) % 100: 0-89 train, 90-94 valid, 95-99 test; names are NFC with whitespace runs collapsed to one space
